package.description: Lightweight, transparent Windows keep-awake utility with intelligent safety pauses.

en-US.description: Lightweight, transparent Windows keep-awake utility with intelligent safety pauses.
en-US.longDescription: IdleHarbor is a native Windows keep-awake utility with optional mouse movement, power-request modes, activity-aware pausing, lock and disconnect safety, battery protection, active hours, session limits, a notification-area menu, and an emergency stop hotkey. It is user-visible, configurable, and does not require a managed runtime.
en-US.name: IdleHarbor
